quest.title: A Superstar... In the Aquarium?
quest.description: Furina seems to be admiring the aquarium...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Mm, I still feel like it's missing something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina? Furina? What are you guys up to?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: What a wonderful way to put it! But the "actors" we're looking for... just so happen to be fish!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Animal actors are hardly a rarity these days. We're looking to cast a charismatic little fishie with just the right attitude to shoot some B-roll... It's essential for setting the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: But I feel like we've seen every fish in the whole aquarium, and none of them quite fit the bill.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: #Should we try asking {NICKNAME} and Paimon for help? They have a knack for solving tricky problems.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's happy you have so much faith in us... but when it comes to casting fish...

choices.text: We could try rounding up some more "candidates"?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Great idea! You're the ones with aquarium management experience, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're saying we should be on the lookout for talent whenever we go swimming? Paimon doesn't see why not!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Then it's settled! I'll fill you in on the attitude we're looking for later.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I guess this makes you "talent scouts"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've really picked up the showbiz vocab since you started hanging out with Furina...
